proves.claim: Init in a copy of a scratch C-only CMake project records its ctest command as the gate.

cli.journeys-languages-c.init-records-ct.why: Without it, a regression where init stops detecting a C CMake project would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A submitted commit with a failing C ctest case is refused red and the refusal names the case.

cli.journeys-languages-c-red.a-failing-c.why: Without it, a regression where a red C gate is accepted or its refusal hides the failing case would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The fixed C commit passes ctest, is accepted and lands on the scratch board main.

cli.journeys-languages-c-land.the-fixed-.why: Without it, a regression where a green C item cannot land would pass unnoticed.
